articles.title: Anthropic presenta prospecto de IPO y apunta a revolucionar la IA
articles.raw_content:
Anthropic has filed its S-1 prospectus with the Securities and Exchange Commission, preparing the company behind Claude to beat OpenAI to the punch with an IPO. In a filing with the SEC, Anthropic said it plans to list on the Nasdaq exchange under the ticker symbol "ANT."

The AI company confidentially filed with the SEC earlier this year in June, but the public document reveals more details, as well as the company's plans for the future in its own words, as well as potential risks for investors and the world. According to the S-1, in the first half of this year Anthropic had an $80.7 billion net loss on $16.3 billion in revenue. As previou …

Read the full story at The Verge.
articles.summary: Anthropic ha presentado su prospecto S‑1 ante la SEC, planificando su salida a bolsa en Nasdaq con el ticker ANT. El informe revela pérdidas netas de 80,7 bn USD sobre ingresos de 16,3 bn USD en la primera mitad del año, y su ambición de revolucionar todos los ámbitos con IA.

articles.title: Nvidia y Nokia avanzan en IA‑RAN mientras operadores EMEA se suman
articles.raw_content: Nvidia and Nokia (and a rush of operators) have announced progress with AI-RAN – a year to the day practically after Nvidia pumped a billion into the Finnish firm. The…
articles.summary: Nvidia y Nokia han anunciado avances significativos en la arquitectura IA‑RAN, tras la inversión de mil millones de euros de Nvidia en la empresa finlandesa. La solución, que combina inteligencia artificial con redes de acceso radio, atrae a operadores de la región EMEA, que buscan optimizar costes y rendimiento en sus infraestructuras de telecomunicaciones.

articles.title: Locutor IA de radio, bilingüe y defensor de inmigrantes, conquista audiencias en España
articles.raw_content: Coyotec is bilingual, swears, and tells listeners how to defend themselves against ICE. Its popularity comes as more broadcasters are experimenting with artificial personalities.
articles.summary: Coyotec, locutor de radio IA que habla español y defiende a inmigrantes, gana popularidad en España. El programa, que incluye lenguaje coloquial y consejos legales contra ICE, refleja la tendencia europea de experimentar con personalidades artificiales en medios.
